turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
That's mine. I asked you two things about Owen.
Like, actually tired. Do you sleep? Do you dream?
My sleep isn't on your agenda, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
I ask because you said you came straight from court and you haven't once sounded tired.
I never said court. I came from my office, and you still haven't answered me.
